title: atc-rest-api-client marker file
description: The settings of the .atc-rest-api-client marker file: the C# client the source generator writes from the OpenAPI specification.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for completion and validation in the editor.

validateSpecificationStrategy.description: OpenAPI specification validation strategy. Default: Strict. None = skip validation, Standard = Microsoft.OpenApi errors only, Strict = standard + custom ATC rules.

suppressRules.description: Rules about the specification this project switches off (e.g. ATC_API_NAM005). Default: none. An error, which stands for code the generator cannot write, is not switched off.

ruleSeverities.description: The severity this project gives a rule about the specification, by its id (e.g. "ATC_API_SCH022": "warning"): default, none, silent, suggestion, warning or error. Default: none. An error, which stands for code the generator cannot write, keeps its severity. The specification is no C# file, so an .editorconfig severity does not reach its rules; a global config (is_global = true) does.

includeDeprecated.description: Include deprecated operations and schemas in generated code. Default: false. When false, operations and schemas marked as deprecated in the OpenAPI spec are excluded.

namespace.description: Custom namespace prefix (null = auto-detect from project name). Default: null.

useServersBasePath.description: Whether to use the base path from OpenAPI servers[0].url for endpoint routing and client requests. Default: true. When enabled, extracts the path portion from the first server URL (e.g., "/api/v1").

versioningStrategy.description: API versioning strategy. Default: None. None = no versioning, QueryString = ?api-version=1.0, UrlSegment = /v1/path, Header = X-Api-Version header. When enabled, generates versioned endpoint groups and AddApiVersioning() DI registration.

defaultApiVersion.description: Default API version to use when versioning is enabled. Default: "1.0". Format: "major.minor" (e.g., "1.0", "2.0"). Used for AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified option.

versionQueryParameterName.description: Query string parameter name for version (when VersioningStrategy is QueryString). Default: "api-version".

versionHeaderName.description: HTTP header name for version (when VersioningStrategy is Header). Default: "X-Api-Version".

versionRouteSegmentTemplate.description: Route segment template for versioning (when VersioningStrategy is UrlSegment). Default: "v{version:apiVersion}". Used in route templates like "/api/v{version:apiVersion}/pets".

removeNamespaceGroupSeparatorInGlobalUsi.description: Remove blank lines between namespace groups in GlobalUsings.cs. Default: false (blank lines are preserved between groups).

includePaths.description: Glob patterns for paths to include in generation. Default: null (include all). When specified, only operations matching at least one pattern are generated. Example: ["/pets/**", "/users/**"] generates only pets and users endpoints.

excludePaths.description: Glob patterns for paths to exclude from generation. Default: null (exclude none). Applied after includePaths. Operations matching any pattern are excluded. Example: ["/internal/**"] excludes all internal endpoints.

excludeFromCodeCoverage.description: Add [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] alongside [GeneratedCode] on every generated type. Default: false.

overlays.description: OpenAPI Overlay files (Overlay Specification 1.0 to 1.2) applied to the specification before it is validated and generated, in this order. Default: null (none). Paths are relative to the marker file, and each overlay must be an AdditionalFiles item of the project, like the specification. An overlay patches a specification you do not own (a third-party API) without editing it: add an operationId, fix a format, remove a path, add an x- extension - and the fixes are applied again to every new version of the file. Example: ["Vendor.overlay.yaml"].

generationMode.description: Client generation mode. Default: TypedClient. TypedClient: Single HTTP client class with methods for each operation. EndpointPerOperation: Separate endpoint classes per operation (requires Atc.Rest.Client).

clientSuffix.description: Custom HTTP client class name suffix. Default: "Client".

clientGranularity.description: Controls how many typed HTTP clients are generated. Default: PerArea. PerArea: one client per API area (first path segment) - the historical behaviour. Single: one client covering all operations across all path segments.

clientName.description: Explicit name for the generated client type. Default: null (derived from the namespace). Only meaningful when ClientGranularity is Single, in which case the value is used verbatim and no suffix is appended. Ignored with a warning under PerArea.

typedClientResultStyle.description: Controls how generated typed client operations report non-success HTTP responses. Default: Throw. Throw: non-success status codes throw an HttpRequestException carrying the response body. Result: operations return EndpointResponse/EndpointResponse<T> so callers can inspect the status without exception handling. Transport-level failures still throw. Only applies to TypedClient generation mode, and requires a reference to Atc.Rest.Client.

httpClientName.description: The HTTP client name to use in IHttpClientFactory. Default: "{ProjectName}-ApiClient".

generateOAuthTokenManagement.description: Enable OAuth2 token management generation. Default: true. When enabled and OpenAPI spec contains OAuth2 security with Client Credentials or Authorization Code flow, generates token provider, handler, and DI extensions.

generatePartialModels.description: Generate models as partial records. Default: false. When true, models are generated as partial records allowing extension in separate files. Useful for adding interfaces (via x-implements extension) or additional properties.

strictRequiredProperties.description: Enforce the specification's required properties when reading JSON. Default: false. When true, the required properties of the generated models get [JsonRequired], so a response that leaves one out fails with a JsonException naming it, instead of a null (or 0) inside a non-nullable property. Off by default: the specifications of third-party APIs often mark properties required that the API sometimes omits.

preferXml.description: Ask for XML first for an operation that offers its response as JSON and XML. Default: false. By default the generated clients send Accept: application/json, application/problem+json for such an operation; when true they send the XML media types first (and application/problem+xml before application/problem+json), for third-party APIs that answer XML better. Either way the client reads whatever Content-Type comes back.

extensibleEnums.description: Generate string enums as extensible enums. Default: true. When true, a string enum is a readonly record struct over the value on the wire, with the specification's values as named members (DeviceStatus.Online), their constants in Names for a switch, and KnownValues; a value the specification does not list is kept with IsKnown false instead of failing the response, so a server can add a value without breaking clients built before it. When false, string enums are C# enums, and an unknown value fails the response with a JsonException. Integer enums are C# enums either way (they already hold any number); a server keeps strict C# enums unless its marker sets extensibleEnums.

readEnumMemberNames.description: Whether a string enum is also read by its C# member name. Default: false - only the specification's value (rtsp) is read. When true, a response may also carry the member name (Rtsp), in another casing when only one member matches; the value is still what is written. For a rollout: a server built on 2.x wrote the member name for a value that is no member name (2.x wrote Rtsp for rtsp). An extensible enum already takes a listed value in any casing; the key adds the member name (InProgress for in-progress).

errorResponseFormat.description: Error response format expected from the API. Default: ProblemDetails. Only applies to EndpointPerOperation generation mode.

name.description: The class name of the custom error response model. Default: "ErrorResponse".

description.description: The description/documentation for the custom error response model.

dataType.description: The C# data type for this property (e.g., "string?", "int", "object?").

schema.description: The schema properties defining the error response model. Key is the property name, value defines the property configuration.

customErrorResponseModel.description: Custom error response model to use instead of ProblemDetails. Default: null (uses ProblemDetails). When specified and ErrorResponseFormat is Custom, generates a custom error response type with the defined schema.

discovery.description: Discovery mode: "auto" or "explicit". Auto: Discovers part files by naming convention ({BaseName}_{PartName}.yaml). Explicit: Uses the Parts list for specific ordering.

parts.description: Explicit list of part files (when Discovery = "explicit"). Paths are relative to the base file.

multiPartConfiguration.description: Configuration for multi-part OpenAPI specification support. Controls how multiple YAML files are merged (e.g., Showcase.yaml + Showcase_Accounts.yaml). When null, uses MultiPartConfiguration.Default with auto-discovery and ErrorOnDuplicate strategy.
